origin.kind: source-generated VelocityVerlet geometry with explicit representation residual

held_realization.input: the original D0Q, not the unrounded SCF matrix or the target benchmark
held_realization.rule: numeric polar(Cq/1e15) conjugates D0Q/1e12; symmetric 1e12 quantization feeds the actual metric pullback at the same generated nuclear current

method.density_matrix: closed-shell spin-summed D; D_alpha = D_beta = D / 2
method.xc_grid_initialization: same level-4 MINAO-pruned source grid; no second SCF

energy_reference.kind: independent same-D functional evaluation; no SCF
energy_reference.legacy_ledger_scf_fields_mean: this same-density reference, not a stationary solution

grid_response.rule: same source MINAO mask, locally fixed; atom-centered coordinates and Becke weights differentiated

method.energy_weighted_density: Qframe = D F(D) S^(-1), generally nonsymmetric; dD = -S^(-1) dB^T D - D dB S^(-1)
method.pulay_column_semantics: local cross-polar frame response, not a stationary orbital-energy assumption

scope: numerical realization of the installed held electronic matrix; same-D BLYP and cross-frame nuclear derivative; no physical time advanced
